item.title: SEO for a Next.js Project: From Concepts to Production
item.description:
When you ship a web app, getting features working is only half the job. The other half is making sure search engines can find your site and understand each page correctly. This post walks through SEO for the Next.js App Router, based on a real project refactor: what SEO is, why it matters, what to configure, and how to manage it after launch.

What Is SEO?

SEO (Search Engine Optimization) is a set of technical and content practices aimed at helping your site appear in organic search results on Google, Bing, and similar engines.

item.title: How to Display Custom Navigation Routes on Google Maps Using the Google Maps JavaScript API
item.description:
1. Background

When using the Google Maps JavaScript API, there may be scenarios where users need to query routes. In such cases, how can navigation routes be displayed on the map?

2. Related Concepts

With the Google Directions API, you can retrieve navigation information between two or more locations — such as distance, duration, and route details on the map. By passing this data to the Maps JavaScript API, it’s possible to render the navigation route directly on an embedded map.
